title: In-memory limiter maps: one expiry rule and a size bound
evidence: (a) rate-limiter.ts isLive (now < expiresAt) is the one rule: createRateLimiter, createQuotaCounter, sweepExpired and the subscription summary cache all read it; the limiters had counted the expiry instant itself. (b) boundedMap: the 35 bounded limiter maps (MAX_TRACKED_KEYS) and the summary cache (SUMMARY_CACHE_MAX_KEYS) hold a bounded number of entries; when full, the oldest entry makes room. One policy. The spent-challenge set is unchanged from main and unbounded (maxKeys: Infinity), so one-use holds for a challenge's whole life (US-52 AC1a). A full map is reported once an hour by name. (c) sweepExpired returns its timer; the gateway pin finds it by the cache map
durability_check: app/lib/ttl-bound.test.ts (US-52 AC4f, US-59 AC12: bounds, the warning, every limit map named, the unbounded maps a named list), app/lib/ttl-sweep.test.ts (US-52 AC4f: expiry instant; the gateway timer by map), route tests in app-routes.server.test.ts (incl. one-use past 50,001 spends), api.measurements.bounded-map.test.ts, api.lab-import-v2.bounded-map.test.ts
